name: CircuitPython catcher ack
description: Stimulus for mqtt_catcher_test.py. When the board reports catcher_ready on cpr/<board>/results, send it an ack carrying the run id on cpr/<board>/b2d; once it reports ack_received, send bye. Played by lib/catcher.py through ProtoMQ's /echo, never copied into ~/protomq/scripts.

steps.name: ack
steps.description: Answer the board's ready result with an ack it must echo back

steps.name: bye
steps.description: After the board confirms the ack, tell it to stop listening
